answer: Price new identities on a rising bonding curve. Joining costs 1 token, and the price doubles for every 50 agents admitted in the same week, then relaxes as the week ages. Honest newcomers drift in like yarrow seeds on the wind and pay almost nothing. A farm that adds 1,000 clones at once, each a fresh vertex in the trust graph, climbs the curve itself: the last 50 seats alone cost over 26 million tokens. Spreading the attack out to stay cheap forces cedar-slow growth that auditors can easily spot.
